question_text: Compare Code Original: 'PH-2026-8941-X' with Code Copy: 'PH-2026-8914-X'. Are they identical?

options.text: No, the digits 41 and 14 are transposed.
No, the checksum letter is different.

hint_ladder.title: Relax muna! Compare the Codes
hint_ladder.text: Time pressure can trick you. Relax, then view both codes. Imagine verifying PWD ID numbers at the barangay; one typo means delayed aid.

hint_ladder.title: Hatian ng Tatlong Chunks
hint_ladder.text: Split into prefix ('PH-2026-'), number group, and suffix ('-X'). Compare each. Sa sari-sari store, isa-isang tinitingnan ang listahan para walang m...

hint_ladder.title: Focus sa Gitnang Numero
hint_ladder.text: Prefix at suffix pareho. Ang difference nasa '8941' vs '8914'—parang nagkapalit ang huling dalawang digits, '41' naging '14'. Classic swap sa data ...

hint_ladder.title: Sagot: Transposition Error
hint_ladder.text: The error is transposition. Piliin ang option na nagsasabing 'the digits 41 and 14 are transposed.' Yan ang tamang sagot, kaya piliin ang B.

A.text: You might have chosen A because a quick glance can make the codes look identical, but the transposition of '41' to '14' is easy to miss.

B.text: Correct. The codes are not identical; '41' and '14' are transposed, exactly the clerical error this test checks for.

C.text: You might have chosen C because the codes share the same prefix, but the difference is actually in the number group, not the prefix.

D.text: You might have chosen D because it's easy to assume the suffix differs, but both end with '-X'; the real error is in the middle digits.

next_time_rule: Gamitin ang 'Pabaliktad' method: basahin code mula dulo, isa-isahin ang digits. Transpositions become obvious—parang pag-verify ng jeepney plate number!
blueprint_id: Clerical Accuracy — Code Verification and Transposition Detection
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo nasa Budget Office ka ng LGU, nagba- verify ka ng Purchase Order numbers. 'PH-2026-8941-X' at 'PH-2026-8914-X'—mukhang pareho pero may maliit na pagkakaiba. Hatiin natin sa tatlo: prefix, number, suffix.

Prefix 'PH-2026-' pareho. Suffix '-X' pareho. Pero 'yung 8941 vs 8914, yung huling dalawang digit nagkapalit. Sa clerical work, isang typo lang, delayed na ang release.

Ang mental trick? Basahin mo pabaliktad, parang plate number ng jeep—'X-1498-6202-HP'—para bawat character makita mo nang isa-isa. Transpositions, mahuhuli mo agad.
